You are a story-package engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, NEVER call a model (not `claude`, not `codex`), NEVER use the network, NEVER run `python -m bench run`, never write factory/state/. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Environment for every command: `export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp`. Ruff (python files only): `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` / `format` (line length 120, Python 3.12). Never pass --cov to pytest. Run tests as `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 <files>`. Tests must be hermetic. Do not add a new test file. If an OLD test pins behaviour this change deliberately changes, update it and say so in NOTES.txt. Write NOTES.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every ambiguity and your choice. Before editing read: AGENTS.md, docs/story-gap-guide.md, docs/scene-fixing-guide.md, docs/world-model-grounding.md and the markdown-story-authoring guide under docs/ (whichever of docs/markdown-story-authoring*.md applies to the source YAML). Context for the owner's diagnosis is in /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/out/chatgpt-19q-diagnosis.md (section 4, 'calendar/photo content is an alternative to the workstation reveal').

PROBLEM. In data/stories/continuity-initiative/source/scenes/1A.yaml storylet `sl_1a_g` (SL-1A-G, 'Kristin reads the kitchen as Michelle's last hour') has two realizations: r1 (claim k_sl_1a_g_r1: workstation, mug, glasses, manuscript pages) and r2 (claim k_sl_1a_g_r2: wall calendar, lake photograph, refrigerator; commits lemon_cake_calendar_read). They are alternatives of ONE storylet: once either fires, the runtime keeps the other spent (storygame/runtime/reveal_eligibility.py `explain_reveal`: STORYLET_SPENT unless the realization is a follow-up, i.e. requires a fact a sibling produces; see storygame/story_package/models.py near line 914). Real consequence, seen in a saved live game: after the player reads the workstation (r1), the calendar and photograph commands never offer r2, so three commands were stuck. WORSE: scene 3A's storylet `Michelle's Proof` (SL-3A-?, guidance.available_while lists `lemon_cake_calendar_read: true`) can only run if the calendar was read, so a player who reads the workstation first can never earn that later payoff. Also r1 and r2 both commit `kitchen_last_hour_read` and `michelle_abduction_suspicion`; the runtime treats a non-repeatable claim whose committed facts are all already true as already established, so a split must not let one reward's commits establish the other's.

CHANGE. Make the calendar/photograph reward its own independent storylet so both discovery orders work and neither consumes the other, without adding any new story content: move the existing r2 realization (its text, says, earn_when, entities, reach, relevance, voiceable, audience, repeatable false, `when: patrol_in_house: false`) into a NEW storylet in 1A.yaml following the same shape as the existing storylets (copy sl_1a_g's guidance/window/boundaries/from_outline/notes structure; same window numbers as sl_1a_g unless the scene's pacing rules need otherwise; new id `sl_1a_l`, storylet_id `SL-1A-L`, title in the same plain style, e.g. 'The Walls of the Kitchen'; check that letter L is unused and pick the next free one otherwise). The new realization is `r1` with realization_id `SL-1A-L-R1` and claim id `k_sl_1a_l_r1`. Its commits must be only `lemon_cake_calendar_read: true` (and keep the other commits ONLY if you can show from the runtime code that doing so does not make the workstation claim already-established; the safe choice is to drop `kitchen_last_hour_read` from the calendar claim and keep `michelle_abduction_suspicion` only on the workstation claim; check what reads each fact with grep across source/ before choosing, and record the result in NOTES.txt). Remove r2 from sl_1a_g and update sl_1a_g's notes (`possible_realizations`, `effects`) so they describe only the workstation. Update the match file 1A.match.yaml: the claim's action_evidence moves unchanged to the new claim id (do NOT broaden any phrase; keep evidence groups identical). Update every reference to the old claim id k_sl_1a_g_r2 across the repo (grep -rn k_sl_1a_g_r2: source, tests/test_richer_1a_fixes.py, tests/test_knowledge_projection.py, tests/test_markdown_story_package.py, tests/test_delivery_restatement.py, tests/test_richer_3a.py, tests/test_factory_diagnose.py, fixtures). You may edit ONLY the three owned files for the story; if a non-owned test or fixture pins the old id or the old storylet shape, do NOT edit it: instead KEEP the claim id `k_sl_1a_g_r2` unchanged for the moved claim (the claim_id field is explicit in the YAML) and its text identical, name the new storylet's realization accordingly, and list in NOTES.txt which non-owned tests forced that. Prefer keeping the old claim id from the start if more than two non-owned files pin it. Never touch tests/fixtures/parity/*. If the story has other rules that key on the storylet list for scene 1A (pacing minimums, window ordering `optional-storylet targets must not precede later gated ones`: new optional storylets need target_turn >= existing forward-activated ones with earliest>0, or fast play is blocked; token/budget pins; gap lint; `.plans` is not yours), satisfy them and say what you checked. Do not change any other storylet, claim text, pacing event, fact purpose, or scene 3A.

TESTS. Add to tests/test_richer_1a_fixes.py (hermetic, real package, fast; find how other tests in that file or tests/test_game_path_completion.py construct a RuntimeState for 1A and apply fired events / facts): (1) workstation first: after the workstation claim is delivered, the calendar claim is still eligible via `explain_reveal`/the runtime's eligible-reveal API (not STORYLET_SPENT) when the patrol is not in the house, and delivering it sets `lemon_cake_calendar_read`; (2) calendar first: after the calendar claim, the workstation claim is still eligible and sets `kitchen_last_hour_read`; (3) both are blocked while `patrol_in_house` is true (the existing `when`); (4) neither is repeatable (a second delivery is not eligible); (5) the scene-3A gate fact `lemon_cake_calendar_read` is produced by the calendar claim alone (use `producers()` from the story-package helpers if available). If the real package loads slowly (> 5 s) share one module-level loaded package.

HARD LIMITS. Edit only the three owned files unless the fallback above applies (then edit fewer, never more). Never edit story files other than 1A.yaml and 1A.match.yaml, never data/ outside those, never storygame/, factory/, bench/, scripts/.
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-19r
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git add -A -- data tests storygame factory
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vE '^(data/stories/continuity-initiative/source/scenes/1A\.yaml|data/stories/continuity-initiative/source/scenes/1A\.match\.yaml|tests/test_richer_1a_fixes\.py)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q 'scenes/1A.yaml' || { echo "1A.yaml unchanged"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python - <<'PYV'
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
src = yaml.safe_load(Path("data/stories/continuity-initiative/source/scenes/1A.yaml").read_text())
text = Path("data/stories/continuity-initiative/source/scenes/1A.yaml").read_text()
assert text.count("Saturday is circled in her handwriting") == 1, "calendar text must appear exactly once"
assert text.count("lemon_cake_calendar_read: true") >= 1
print("source sanity ok")
PYV
start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 tests/test_richer_1a_fixes.py tests/test_knowledge_projection.py tests/test_markdown_story_package.py tests/test_delivery_restatement.py tests/test_richer_3a.py tests/test_factory_diagnose.py tests/test_game_path_completion.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "story tests took $took s (budget 600 s)"
[ "$took" -le 600 ] || { echo "over the 600 s budget"; exit 1; }
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep '\.py$' || true)
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/calendar-split.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/calendar-split.patch"
